- `theme/badge.toml` → [mobile/assets/badge.json](/home/ftmon/whyfs-provenance-decision-20260929T125733/cases/case03-whyfs/mobile/assets/badge.json)

Therefore, a color change may affect those three generated files.

Completeness limitation: these are observed dependencies only, not an exhaustive dependency graph. The provenance record is incomplete because the origin of `theme/badge.toml` was not observed; unobserved consumers may exist.

No files were modified.

command_rows.command:
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 4 -printf '%y %p\\n' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
printf '\\nGit status:\\n'
git status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true
printf '\\nRoot details:\\n'
ls -la
printf '\\nMetadata-like files:\\n'
rg --files --hidden | rg '("'^|/)('"\\.why|why|prov|trace|log|manifest|ledger|record|build|Makefile|package\\.json)' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' README.md
printf '\\n.gitignore:\\n'
sed -n '1,120p' .gitignore
printf '\\nContents and timestamps:\\n'
for f in theme/badge.toml web/assets/badge.svg mobile/assets/badge.json docs/badge.txt tools/build-badges.js; do stat --printf='%n\\n  inode=%i size=%s mtime=%y ctime=%z\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,20p' \""'$f"; done
printf '"'\\nExtended attributes:\\n'
for f in theme/badge.toml web/assets/badge.svg mobile/assets/badge.json docs/badge.txt tools/build-badges.js; do echo \""'$f"; getfattr -d -m - "$f" 2>&1 || true; done
printf '"'\\nMount and whyfs commands:\\n'
findmnt -T . -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
command -v whyfs || true
compgen -c | rg -i 'whyfs|provenance' | sort -u | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "whyfs --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,240p'
printf '\\nVersion/info:\\n'
whyfs --version 2>&1 || true
printf '\\nWhyfs-related environment names:\\n'
env | cut -d= -f1 | rg -i 'why|prov|trace|mcp' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "whyfs status 2>&1
printf '\\nimpact help:\\n'
whyfs impact --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,220p'
printf '\\nask help/questions:\\n'
whyfs ask 2>&1 | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "whyfs ask dependents theme/badge.toml
printf '\\nimpact default:\\n'
whyfs impact theme/badge.toml --json
printf '\\nimpact deeper:\\n'
whyfs impact theme/badge.toml --depth 10 --json
printf '\\nsource label:\\n'
whyfs label theme/badge.toml --json"
